scope: Read-only current order-line validation and submission RPC inspection; no customer records, schema changes or writes.

triggers.trigger_definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_validate_order_line_family_selection BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF family_id, product_option_id, requested_presentation, brand_preference_mode, requested_brand, product_option_snapshot ON public.order_lines FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION validate_order_line_family_selection()

submission_functions.arguments: p_school_id uuid, p_submission_key uuid, p_lines jsonb, p_note text
